components.success_condition_check: Measurand, realization and result defined with specification conditions (MU 23-34); error, correction and standard uncertainty distinguished, uncertainty explicitly not the realized error or a bound (MU 47-66, 68-75). Explicit quantity, units, input roles and uncertain corrections: power model with roles of V, R0, alpha, t, t0 and sensitivities (MU 120-138); end-gauge target 'length at 20 C' of nominal 50 mm with model in l_S, d, alpha, theta and a table giving each input and correction (standard length, comparator random- and systematic-effect corrections, temperatures, expansion coefficients) a unit-bearing standard uncertainty (MU 525-572). Uncertain corrections remain in the model (MU 59-63, 114-118).
components.failure_condition_check: Uncertainty is never treated as an observed error (MU 53-56, 64-66 state the opposite); the standard deviation of readings is not treated as every source: incomplete specification, corrections and Type B components enter separately (MU 30-33, 73-75, 551-567).

components.success_condition_check: Type A and Type B defined as evaluation methods, explicitly not random/systematic classes and not reliability ranks, with cross-examples (MU 143-153). Information sources explained: series of observations with the sample-covariance theorem and proof (MU 155-180; MUa 4-20); certificates, stated bounds with declared distributions and conversions (MU 201-290). Each evaluation is attached to one model: the end-gauge table assigns Type A (13 nm/sqrt5) and Type B (certificate/3, uniform/sqrt3, sine/sqrt2) evaluations to the inputs of the same measurement equation (MU 546-572); the common probabilistic treatment is stated as an interpretive model choice (MU 105-112, 353-358).
